WITH district_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        a.district_id,
        d.A3 as region,
        COUNT(*) as client_count
    FROM disp
    JOIN account a ON disp.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
    GROUP BY a.district_id, d.A3
),
region_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        SUM(client_count) as region_total
    FROM district_counts
    GROUP BY region
),
grand_total AS (
    SELECT SUM(client_count) as total FROM district_counts
)
SELECT 
    dc.district_id,
    dc.region,
    dc.client_count,
    dc.client_count * 1.0 / rt.region_total as share_of_region,
    dc.client_count * 1.0 / gt.total as share_of_total
FROM district_counts dc
JOIN region_totals rt ON dc.region = rt.region
CROSS JOIN grand_total gt
ORDER BY share_of_total DESC
LIMIT 10
